study_identification_part.si_4_title: Resting-State Changes in Aging and Parkinson ' s Disease Are Shaped by Underlying Neurotransmission: A Normative Modeling Study

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Bayesian linear regression with 5 knot basis splines and sinh-arcsinh warping (PCNtoolkit).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: To account for non-linear trajectories and non-Gaussian variance of the normal co-localization levels, we used Bayesian linear regression (5 knot basis splines and sinh-arcsinh warping) with age and sex as covariates.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: 1-s2.0-S2451902224001125-mmc1.pdf.md: Normative modeling of brain function - neurotransmitter co-localization

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Co-localization levels (Spearman correlation coefficients) between neurotransmitter systems and fALFF, LCOR, GCOR maps.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We modeled the co-localization level (i.e., the Spearman correlation coefficient) derived from spatial correlation analyses between neurotransmitter systems (n = 19) and individual brain functional measures (fALFF, LCOR, and GCOR) of all healthy controls.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: 1-s2.0-S2451902224001125-mmc1.pdf.md: Normative modeling of brain function - neurotransmitter co-localization

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were included as covariates in the normative models.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: To account for non-linear trajectories and non-Gaussian variance of the normal co-localization levels, we used Bayesian linear regression (5 knot basis splines and sinh-arcsinh warping) with age and sex as covariates.
